body: Should the branch name also include the `OWNER:` portion if the pull request is coming from a different repo? This would match how head branches are shown on GitHub web.

It's fine to return nil in place of pointers when an error occurs:
```suggestion
		return nil, err
```

Re: "Reimagine how the app determines its context": my intent was not to suggest that all the goals I've outlined in #2 are reachable within the course of a week. Rather, I had imagined this as something to keep in mind _over the long term_ as we develop prototype and stable features and perform mini-refactoring of underlying mechanisms as we go along.
